name: Yoto
source:
A cat ear warrior with power and agility to wield a huge axe easily.
Originally from a poor village, she left to pursue a better life.
A glutton and good-nature girl, she was saved by Lelesia when in trouble.
After learning to have sex, she becomes more and more active in "Koobi".
